name: manual_95b200
claim: lan_peer_assign.py's 'read' command (non-JSON mode) crashes on Windows with UnicodeEncodeError when a peer message body contains non-cp1252 characters (e.g. arrow U+2192) -- print() hits the Windows console codepage, not UTF-8. Use --json plus PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 to read message bodies reliably on Windows.

decisions.notes: Hit live reading a real Mac coordination message containing a unicode arrow in its title -- plain 'lan_peer_assign.py read --peer ...' crashed with a traceback instead of printing the body.

rationale: Hit live reading a real Mac coordination message containing a unicode arrow in its title -- plain 'lan_peer_assign.py read --peer ...' crashed with a traceback instead of printing the body.
